about: Issue 462 (ADR-0039 amendment of 14 November 2026, revised 15 November 2026; docs/architecture/462-lockout-contract.md section R). The sign-in server's policy (ansible/roles/authentik/templates/password-pause.py) must give these answers; since 15 November 2026 these vectors live in workforce-deploy only (the application asks the sign-in server, contract R.7.2). Times are UTC. A marker is the later of the account's password change and its newest unlock record. A case's config is the sign-in server's environment (SIGN_IN_WORKPLACE_SOURCE_LIMIT, SIGN_IN_WORKPLACE_NETWORK_LIMIT, CLIENT_ADDRESSES_CONFIRMED). A signed event is a completed sign-in (the right password and the right code). Expect's rule says whose words are shown: source, network or paused.
